Cream-colored hood with a plastic visor, mounted on a dark stand with wheels.
A logo badge reads 'EQUATOR' with what appears to be a '2' below it (photo 1 and photo 2).
Power cord is visible running down from the unit to the floor (photo 1).
Background shows a window, curtain, another white dryer unit, and a wrapped mannequin head, indicating a salon setting.
No close-up of the control panel, buttons, timer dial, or plug is visible in any photo.
No photo shows the unit powered on or air/heat being produced.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the control knobs/switches on the hood

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used Equator salon hood hair dryer, but no functional proof (power-on, controls, cord condition) is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-verified/possibly non-working unit until further proof is given.
